en.html:
A silver warrior—the Silver Star—had appeared. The army that had been surrounding Muramasa—Rokuhara or the occupation force, whichever—had gone mad. That must be the thing they called mental contamination.

Part of it had formed a ragged column and was heading toward Katase.
She had to stop them. It would be a catastrophe.

But Muramasa—Kageaki—could not leave that spot.
Someone else would have to go.

Which meant her. Obviously!

en.html: For Ichijou, deciding and doing started from the same coordinate. Hesitation, dithering, that kind of entropy: zero. If she thought at all, it was only about how to reach the goal. —What must be done? She could not cut straight through to Katase. That road would probably pull her into the "contaminated" zone. She would have to go around by the island's outer edge as far as possible. Would that be in time? Any other way?◆ —None. Question closed. And after arriving? How do you stop an armed army? Any way except going in just as she was?◆ —None. Question closed. Thinking over. Only the doing remained.
en.text:
For Ichijou, deciding and doing started from the same coordinate. Hesitation, dithering, that kind of entropy: zero.

If she thought at all, it was only about how to reach the goal.

—What must be done?

She could not cut straight through to Katase. That road would probably pull her into the "contaminated" zone.

She would have to go around by the island's outer edge as far as possible.
Would that be in time?

Any other way?◆
—None. Question closed.

And after arriving? How do you stop an armed army?

Any way except going in just as she was?◆
—None. Question closed.

Thinking over.
Only the doing remained.

ja.html: 一条にとって、決断と行動の起点は同座標にある。 　躊躇い、逡巡などというエントロピーは皆無だ。 　考えることがあるとすればそれは目的を達する為の 思索に限られる。 　 　――どうすれば良いか。 　片瀬まで最短距離を抜けては行けない。 　それではおそらく〝汚染〟の範囲に巻き込まれる。 　可能な限り島の外縁を経由して向かう必要がある。 　それで間に合うか。 　他に手段は？◆ 　――無し。この点の考察を打ち切る。 　辿り着いた後はどうするか。 　武装した軍隊をどう止める？ 　このまま・・・・立ち向かう以外の方法は？◆ 　――無し。この点の考察を打ち切る。 　思考終了。 　後は可能行動を実施するだけだった。
ja.text:
一条にとって、決断と行動の起点は同座標にある。
　躊躇い、逡巡などというエントロピーは皆無だ。


　考えることがあるとすればそれは目的を達する為の
思索に限られる。
　
　――どうすれば良いか。

　片瀬まで最短距離を抜けては行けない。
　それではおそらく〝汚染〟の範囲に巻き込まれる。

　可能な限り島の外縁を経由して向かう必要がある。
　それで間に合うか。

　他に手段は？◆
　――無し。この点の考察を打ち切る。

　辿り着いた後はどうするか。
　武装した軍隊をどう止める？

　このまま・・・・立ち向かう以外の方法は？◆
　――無し。この点の考察を打ち切る。

　思考終了。
　後は可能行動を実施するだけだった。

The one she had run into was someone she knew.
Not a friend, by any stretch.

Ichizo Sorimachi.
A small-time gangster eating from two plates, the shogunate's hired Nogiyama Group and the occupation force both.

Why was he in a place like this—?

Several facts snapped together in Ichijou's head. His wounds. His half-drowned look. His record. The little scene from a short while ago.

en.html:
Sorimachi"Ohh... frightening, frightening..."
Ichijou"..."
Sorimachi"No obstruction from my side... Only, madam, aage ka socha? What will you do there?"
Sorimachi"The other side is an army. One fist is not going to stop that, is it...?"
Ichijou"Won't know till I try."
Sorimachi"Without trying also, is the answer not showing?"
Ichijou"Ek baat pakki hai. Stand here saying 'no use, no use', doing nothing—and nobody gets saved."
Sorimachi"................ Heh-heh."
Ichijou"Try, and maybe somebody gets saved. That is why I am going."
Sorimachi"Madam."
Ichijou"Later."
Sorimachi"Madam requires power, perhaps?"
Ichijou"..."
Sorimachi"Power to scatter even an army... you want that right now, don't you?"
Ichijou"What are you getting at, you bastard?"
Sorimachi"I used this lighthouse for camping too... and as it happens, I have something right here."
Sorimachi"Here... the tool for the operation entrusted to me."
Ichijou"...?"
Sorimachi"Mind you, pehle uthaake laaye—first I hauled the thing all the way here. Then I discovered it cannot be used for that purpose. Chooses its own master, this one..."
Sorimachi"But... madam, perhaps you..."

en.html:
Katase Beach—or should one now say the former beach—was in the middle of chaos.
With Enoshima having flown in at them, nobody was going to keep sleeping peacefully under a warm quilt.

The damage from tsunami and earthquake was strangely small (for a whole island to have slammed into the shore). Yet that only underlined how unreal reality had become, and gave people a terror they could not make sense of.

The police turned out by the emergency call were no exception. Far from calming the confusion, they could barely hold their own ranks together.

en.html:
After somehow gathering his unreliable men into order, Akitaka Kikuchi—chief of Kamakura Police—reached the point where island met Katase. What waited for him, however, was no lead toward solving the emergency.

It was the herald of a fresh calamity.
—Heavy, frantic machine noise. Screams that meant nothing.

The chief, a veteran of battlefields, knew at once.
An army.

A small military unit that, for some reason, had lost all command and fallen into total rampage.
A pack of starving wolves that killed, wrecked and ravaged.

Small or not, its strength was more than enough to burn the whole Katase area to scorched earth. Scattering a lightly armed police unit as an appetizer would be easy.

「あいつ・・・か……」

en.html:
The chief groaned that pronoun.

—That thing.

He did not know how events had gone on Enoshima, where he had sent Kageaki. But it seemed they had finally drawn the winning ticket.

The Silver Star had manifested...
And had presumably driven the military unit on the island mad.

—Nine times out of ten, this whole affair was a GHQ trap.
That was the chief's reading. But he had never convinced himself that the Silver Star could not appear.

This outcome had been inside his calculations.
But he had reckoned that whatever happened would stay inside the island.
That civilians would come to no harm.
...Naive.

Enoshima ending up beside Katase Beach, this nobody could have predicted—
But that such a derangement might overturn the whole situation, this he should have kept in mind.

He had heard Kageaki's reports again and again, and knew the Silver Star's abnormality better than any man but Kageaki himself!
His fist shook with regret. But it was too late.

The chief saw it.
Behind him, murmurs; his men had seen it too.

A black whirl of men, vehicles, flesh and iron.
Howling out of step, running in every direction, yet advancing as one mass.

Like a Juggernaut—a divine carriage that trampled men to death and sent them to paradise—it came toward Katase, dancing with joy at the slaughter.

The chief ordered his men into interception formation.
He understood how much good it would do.

However they struggled, they could not stop it.
At best, they might cut a thousand dead down to nine hundred.

Water on a hot stone.
And it was he who had neglected to stock liquid nitrogen.

Holding his frightened men in place, the Kamakura chief swallowed his shame and made up his mind: through his own incompetence, a thousand human beings would die.

ja.html:
その代名詞を、署長は呻いた。
　
　――<ruby>銀星号<rt>あいつ</rt></ruby>。

　景明を送り込んだ江ノ島で、何がどう推移したのか
はわからない。
　だがどうやら最後には<ruby>当たり<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>を引いたようだ。

　銀星号は顕現し……
　そして、島にいた軍部隊を狂わせたのだろう。

　――今回の件は十中八九、ＧＨＱの罠。
　署長はそう見ていたが、といって銀星号が現れる事
は絶対に無いなどと思い込んではいなかった。

　かくあるも考慮の内ではあった。
　が、何が起ころうと島の中の事で済む――と、そう
踏んでいたのだ。

　市民に害が及ぶことはなかろうと。
　……甘かった。

　江ノ島と片瀬海岸が隣接するなど、予測できた筈も
ないが――
　そのような狂変が情勢を根底から覆す可能性も有り
得るとは、考えておいて然るべきであった。

　幾度も景明の報告を聞き、銀星号の尋常ならざるを
彼に次ぐほどに知る身であったのだから！
　拳が悔恨に震える。しかしもう遅い。

　署長は見た。
　背後でざわめき。彼の部下らも見たのだろう。

　黒々とした、人と車と肉と鉄の渦。
　不揃いに吠え、ばらばらに駆け、だが一塊となって
突き進む。

　あたかも<ruby>祝福の戦車<rt>ジャガノート</rt></ruby>。
　人々を踏み殺して極楽へ送る神の輿のように、殺戮
を喜び踊りながら、それは片瀬へ向かって来る。

　署長は部下に迎撃隊形を指示した。
　その効果の程を理解しながら。

　どう足掻こうと、防ぎ止めることはできない。
　おそらく、千の死者を九百に減らすくらいが限度。

　焼け石に水だ。
　しかし液体窒素の備えを怠ったのは彼だった。

　浮き足立つ部下を抑えつつ、鎌倉署長は恥を呑み、
覚悟を決めた。
　己の無能によって千の人間を殺す、その覚悟を。
